# Chapter 1 — global footnote numbering

This HTML book keeps reusable-footnote identity local to each chapter page while continuing the displayed footnote numbers across chapters.

José Afonso da Silva is cited first.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

The same citation appears again in this chapter and reuses footnote **1**.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

The Constitution receives footnote **2**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

The next chapter therefore begins at **3**, even though its reusable-footnote scope is independent.
